Folks — quick suggestions on cadence and copy based on similar invites that drove the best RSVP->attend conversion: 

1) Segmented subject lines (send variant A to “Architects” list, variant B to “Platform Engineers”):
   - Variant A (Architects): “Architect-level deep dive: LLM serving optimizations”
   - Variant B (Platform): “Reduce LLM inference latency — real patterns & configs”

2) Reminder schedule (we recommend): 7d, 72h (soft nudge), 24h (hard CTA + calendar attachment), 1h (final reminder with join link). Add a 48h variant for high-value accounts like ACME.

3) Tracking link mapping (high level):
   - Primary CTA (email button): https://redwood.ai/events/llm-serving-deep-dive?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=acme_primary
   - Panelist follow-up link (for technical appendix): https://redwood.ai/tech/appendix?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=acme_appendix
